$comment: One SDK for the whole tree: the 10.0 SDK builds every target here, net8.0 and net10.0 (the core,
the suite) and net8.0-windows and net10.0-windows (the AutoCAD shell and the Civil 3D part).
The plugin ships two builds because AutoCAD and Civil 3D 2025 and 2026 run .NET 8 and 2027 runs
.NET 10. A .NET 8 project cannot reference an API assembly built for .NET 10 (CS1705), so each
build compiles against its own API directory (Directory.Build.props).
rollForward latestFeature keeps this on 10.0.x: a machine with a newer 10.0 patch band builds
without editing this file, and a machine with only 8/9 fails loudly instead of silently
